DISASSEMBLY OF OUTPUT SHAFT ASSEMBLY

1. REMOVE OUTPUT SHAFT CENTER BEARING AND FIRST GEAR ASSEMBLY
(a) Shift No.1 hub sleeve onto the 2nd gear.
(b) Using a press, remove the center bearing, 1st gear, needle roller bearing, inner race and synchronizer ring.

WM0051

2. REMOVE LOCKING BALL
Using a magnetic finger, remove the locking ball.

WM0052
